## Summary
After hearing many requests for a showMore/infiniteHits widget and given the fact that this feature exists in `React-Instantsearch`, @bobylito helped me bring it to `Instantsearch.js`! 🎉  🍾  🔎 

The **InfiniteHits widget** should be used as a replacement for the regular Hits widget, _not_ along with it.
It will replicate the Hits widget API and rendering and add a button at the bottom that is customizable with a label and CSS classes.
This widget shouldn't be used with the pagination widget since the 2 features overlap.
